default: A hospitality property management system (PMS) helps lodging teams organize reservations, room availability, guest records, billing and daily operations.

name: text_4
label: What is GraceSoft Easy InnKeeping?
default: What is GraceSoft Easy InnKeeping?

name: text_5
label: Easy InnKeeping is GraceSoft’s cloud-based hospitality PMS, with
default: Easy InnKeeping is GraceSoft’s cloud-based hospitality PMS, with connected booking, distribution, guest engagement and operational tools.

name: text_6
label: What types of properties does GraceSoft support?
default: What types of properties does GraceSoft support?

name: text_7
label: GraceSoft serves independent hotels, motels, bed and breakfasts,
default: GraceSoft serves independent hotels, motels, bed and breakfasts, inns, resorts, vacation rentals, campgrounds, RV parks, dude ranches, condos and multi-property businesses.

name: text_8
label: Can guests book directly through my property website?
default: Can guests book directly through my property website?

name: text_9
label: Yes. The Easy InnKeeping booking engine lets guests check av
default: Yes. The Easy InnKeeping booking engine lets guests check availability and reserve directly through your website.

name: text_10
label: Will it work with my booking channels and payment provider?
default: Will it work with my booking channels and payment provider?

name: text_11
label: GraceSoft lists channels including Booking.com, Expedia, Air
default: GraceSoft lists channels including Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb and Vrbo, and payment providers including Stripe, Square, Authorize.Net and Shift4. Ask GraceSoft to confirm support for your channels and provider in your region and configuration.

name: text_12
label: Can GraceSoft manage multiple properties?
default: Can GraceSoft manage multiple properties?

name: text_13
label: Yes. GraceSoft offers multi-property management, including access
default: Yes. GraceSoft offers multi-property management, including access to multiple properties through a unified login. Discuss portfolio requirements with the team.

name: text_14
label: Does GraceSoft offer AI Voice and Chat Assistants?
default: Does GraceSoft offer AI Voice and Chat Assistants?

name: text_15
label: Yes. GraceSoft describes AI voice and chat options for property q
default: Yes. GraceSoft describes AI voice and chat options for property questions, availability, rates and booking inquiries, including outside normal desk hours.

name: text_20
label: Does GraceSoft provide mobile access?
default: Does GraceSoft provide mobile access?

name: text_21
label: Yes. GraceSoft describes cloud access from desktop, tablet and mo
default: Yes. GraceSoft describes cloud access from desktop, tablet and mobile, with apps for Android, iPhone and iPad. Confirm the workflows available on your device.

name: text_22
label: Can I see the software before deciding?
default: Can I see the software before deciding?

name: text_23
label: Yes. Request a demo and tell GraceSoft which workflows you w
default: Yes. Request a demo and tell GraceSoft which workflows you want to see, such as arrivals, direct bookings or guest messaging.

name: text_24
label: How much does Easy InnKeeping cost?
default: How much does Easy InnKeeping cost?

name: text_25
label: Visit the GraceSoft pricing page to compare options. If you
default: Visit the GraceSoft pricing page to compare options. If you also need a property website, ask which website services and fees apply.

name: text_26
label: Can I bring over existing reservations and guest records?
default: Can I bring over existing reservations and guest records?

name: text_27
label: Tell GraceSoft which system you use and what records you nee
default: Tell GraceSoft which system you use and what records you need to move. Ask which imports are supported and who will handle each step before setting a switch date.
